title: Linda Brown sees a $100,000 check from the Townsend Brown Foundation to Stanford
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Linda Brown sees a $100,000 check from the Townsend Brown Foundation to Stanford, about 1970s at Stanford Research Institute, Menlo Park, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And Linda, who was visiting her father in Atherton at that time, remembers seeing a check from the Townsend Brown Foundation to Stanford for $100,000.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, in a film about an inventor named Townsend Brown, who he says built flying-saucer-like devices, relays a memory from Brown's daughter, Linda. She remembers that in the 1970s, while visiting her father in Atherton, California, she saw a check for $100,000 from his foundation made out to Stanford, the nearby university and research institute. It is told as a sign that Brown's work was quietly tied to serious research.
